title: CONTINUED CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (PADILLA - NAZARIAN) and RESOLUTION relative to the issuance of conduit revenue bonds for the purpose of financing,…
text:
[Council File 26-1546; CD 6]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
CONTINUED CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (PADILLA - NAZARIAN) and RESOLUTION relative to the issuance of conduit revenue bonds for the purpose of financing, refinancing and/or reimbursing the Borrower for the acquisition, improvement, furnishing and equipping of certain educational and ancillary facilities located at 14701 Friar Street and 14704 Victory Boulevard and a 12,500 parcel of vacant land located across Friar Street and identified as Los Angeles County Assessor Parcel Number 2241-007-027 in Council District Six (CD 6).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. HOLD a Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA) public hearing at the City Council Meeting to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
2. ADOPT the accompanying TEFRA RESOLUTION, attached to the Motion, to allow the California Enterprise Development Authority to issue bonds in an amount not to exceed $16,000,000 to provide financing for the acquisition, improvement, furnishing and equipping of certain educational and ancillary facilities located at 14701 Friar Street and 14704 Victory Boulevard and a 12,500 parcel of vacant land located across Friar Street and identified as Los Angeles County Assessor Parcel Number 2241-007-027 in Council District Six (CD 6).
(Continued from Council meeting of November 6, 2026.)
summary: Council adoption of a TEFRA resolution that lets the California Enterprise Development Authority issue up to $16 million in conduit revenue bonds to finance educational facilities at 14701 Friar St and 14704 Victory Blvd and a nearby vacant parcel in Council District 6.

locations.text: Vacant parcel across Friar St, APN 2241-007-027, Los Angeles, CA
